latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of gemini-image-proxy.

- Generate and edit images with Gemini 3 Pro Image using the OpenAI Python SDK.
- Requires only the openai package (no extra dependencies like pillow or google-genai).
- Works on Fly.io free tier and in containers with pip/uv.
- Supports image generation and editing via simple CLI script.
- Configurable with GOOGLE_PROXY_API_KEY and GOOGLE_PROXY_BASE_URL environment variables.
- Compatible with multiple image models, defaults to gemini-3-pro-image.
- Easy setup and usage for any Python 3.10+ environment.
